# Zampa Club

> Zampa Club (shop.zampaclub.it) is a modern pet boutique and online store curated for dogs, cats, and small pets, featuring ergonomic harnesses, orthopedic beds, cat trees, smart feeders, and travel gear connected directly to WooCommerce checkout.

## Storefront & Shopping

- [Zampa Club Storefront](https://shop.zampaclub.it/): Browse the full pet catalog, filter by pet or need, and select product variations.
- [Dogs Collection](https://shop.zampaclub.it/#product-catalog): Ergonomic harnesses, leashes, apparel, interactive toys, and comfort essentials for dogs.
- [Cats Collection](https://shop.zampaclub.it/#product-catalog): Nordic cat trees, scratchers, circulating water fountains, and interactive cat toys.
- [Home & Comfort](https://shop.zampaclub.it/#product-catalog): Orthopedic memory foam beds and calming donut beds.
- [Travel & Gear](https://shop.zampaclub.it/#product-catalog): Pet carriers, car seat covers, and walk accessories.
- [Food & Treats](https://shop.zampaclub.it/#product-catalog): Wi-Fi automatic feeders, feeding mats, bowls, and quiet water fountains.

## Checkout & Account

- [WooCommerce Checkout](https://zampaclub.it/pagamento/): Encrypted checkout powered by WooCommerce.
- [Customer Account](https://zampaclub.it/my-account/): Order history, tracking, and account management.

## Policies & Support

- Shipping: Free US shipping on orders over $39 ($4.90 flat rate below), tracked delivery in 4-7 business days.
- Returns: Easy 30-day returns and size exchanges.
- Contact: hello@zampaclub.it
